interpretation.both: Possible overdrying and underdrying signs present — check trolley carefully
interpretation.steam: Steam timing issue — no product defect signs yet

Amber: Find the cause (steam timing, airflow, orientation, loading).
Notify the dried supervisor this shift.
Red: Notify the dried manager and QC manager now.
Critical: Ring fence the trolley and tag it.
Do not move it to packing.
Notify Rowan and Phila immediately, with photos.

over: Overdrying signs: add an extra steam, reduce wind, rotate the trolley.
under: Underdrying signs: steam now, move to Windhoek with maximum airflow, remove and isolate mould pieces.
steam: Steam deviation: record the deviation and complete the steam immediately.

entryFields.label: Skin
entryFields.howToCheck: Look at the skin and run a finger over it.

scoreOptions.label: 0 — Ideal
scoreOptions.detail: Dry skin that still flexes, drying at the same speed as the meat

scoreOptions.label: 1 — Warning
scoreOptions.detail: Skin turning smooth and firming ahead of the meat

scoreOptions.label: 3 — Failed
scoreOptions.detail: Dry, smooth, hard crust

entryFields.label: Core
entryFields.howToCheck: Press the centre of the foot firmly with a thumb. Read skin and core together: hard skin + soft core = case hardening (overdrying); soft skin + soft core = underdrying (check sticky and mould).

scoreOptions.label: 0 — Ideal
scoreOptions.detail: Core firming at the same rate as the skin

scoreOptions.label: 1 — Warning
scoreOptions.detail: Core noticeably softer than the skin

scoreOptions.label: 3 — Failed
scoreOptions.detail: Core soft or wet when cut

entryFields.label: Frills
entryFields.howToCheck: Feel test: run fingers along the beard, frills and foot edge.

scoreOptions.label: 0 — Ideal
scoreOptions.detail: Edges dry and firm but not sharp. Frills dry and elastic

scoreOptions.label: 1 — Warning
scoreOptions.detail: Frill tips stiffening, foot edge starting to sharpen

scoreOptions.label: 3 — Failed
scoreOptions.detail: Frills and beard spiky and crusty, foot edge sharp and hard

entryFields.label: Shape
entryFields.howToCheck: Look at the gap where the frill meets the adductor muscle. Look for curl and dents.

scoreOptions.label: 0 — Ideal
scoreOptions.detail: Tight, closed shape. Small to no gap between frill and adductor

scoreOptions.label: 1 — Warning
scoreOptions.detail: Gap widening, edges starting to curl

scoreOptions.label: 3 — Failed
scoreOptions.detail: Big gap where the frill has pulled away from the adductor; dents and distortion

entryFields.label: Colour
entryFields.howToCheck: Compare against the Score 0 reference photo for the same day. Darkening is only a defect when ahead of schedule.

scoreOptions.label: 0 — Ideal
scoreOptions.detail: Colour matches the reference for this day

scoreOptions.label: 1 — Warning
scoreOptions.detail: Slightly darker than the reference

scoreOptions.label: 3 — Failed
scoreOptions.detail: Clearly darker, well ahead of schedule

entryFields.label: Wrinkles
entryFields.howToCheck: Look at the side of the foot. Pass or fail only.

scoreOptions.label: 0 — Pass
scoreOptions.detail: Smooth

scoreOptions.label: 2 — Fail
scoreOptions.detail: Wrinkled

entryFields.label: Sticky
entryFields.howToCheck: Slide a clean, dry finger across the skin. Pass or fail only.

scoreOptions.label: 0 — Pass
scoreOptions.detail: Smooth and dry, finger slides freely

scoreOptions.label: 2 — Fail
scoreOptions.detail: Sticky, finger cannot slide over the skin

entryFields.label: Mould
entryFields.howToCheck: Zero tolerance. Turn pieces over. Check the underside and every point where pieces touch each other or the trolley. Mould vs bloom: fully dried product can grow an even dry white bloom of protein, which is quality, not mould. Mould is raised or fuzzy spots, usually where pieces touch. If in doubt, score 2 and call supervision. Score 2 or 3: remove and isolate the affected pieces immediately and check the remaining pieces one by one.

scoreOptions.label: 0 — None
scoreOptions.detail: No spots

scoreOptions.label: 2 — Isolated
scoreOptions.detail: One or two small spots (white, grey, green or black) on a single piece

scoreOptions.label: 3 — Spread
scoreOptions.detail: Spots on more than one piece, fuzzy growth, or any spread

scoreOptions.label: 0 — Clean
scoreOptions.detail: Clean, normal dried smell

scoreOptions.label: 1 — Warning
scoreOptions.detail: Slightly sour

scoreOptions.label: 3 — Failed
scoreOptions.detail: Clearly sour, ammonia or off odour

entryFields.label: Steam timing
entryFields.howToCheck: Read the trolley card and compare the recorded steam times with the schedule. The Day 1 morning steam (straight out of Windhoek) is the most critical steam: missing it scores 3 immediately.

scoreOptions.label: 0 — On schedule
scoreOptions.detail: All steams done in their round

scoreOptions.label: 1 — Late
scoreOptions.detail: A steam done late, after its round

scoreOptions.label: 3 — Missed
scoreOptions.detail: A steam missed, or the Day 1 morning steam not done
